_doc: Vharlen's own road events (Expansion 1), laid over data/provinces/road-events.json key by key (js/sim/province-files.js): `chests`, `deliver`, `escort`, `rescue`, `thanks` and `deliverTargets` are the island's; `rules` and `coded` (the escort ambush) are the home file's. Same record shapes as the home file (read its _doc). Each record carries `words` = [what (one sentence), objective text, onSuccess, onFail] with the same {name} {town} {npc} {role} {guards} slots; tools/content-events.mjs --province=vharlen turns them into the `info` block. Chest `look`s are the island ones; guards are island monsters (data/rules/monsters-tv.json). INFO (play-test 5 T12, tools/content-events.mjs): every chest and every deliver / escort / rescue variant carries `info` = { name, what (one sentence), objective { kind, text, count, unit }, durationSec, onSuccess, onFail, rewardText } with the same {name} {town} {npc} {guards} slots as the rest of the record; `coded` holds the info of kinds the server starts from code (the escort `ambush`). Never edit `info` by hand: change the words in the tool and re-run it.

chests.name: Tipped Sulphur Cart
chests.blurb: A hand cart on its side, sulphur spilled yellow across the road, a strongbox still lashed underneath.
words: A sulphur cart lies tipped on its side with a strongbox still lashed under the baskets.
Search the tipped sulphur cart
You take what the porters left behind, and smell of eggs for an hour.
Somebody else got to the cart first.

Kill what is picking at the wreck, then search its cargo
The cargo is yours, and the sea will not miss it.
The scavengers drag the cargo off into the rocks.

ambush._doc: js/sim/roadevents.js ambush(): monsters of the nearest camp jump an escort every rules.ambushEveryM metres walked, at most rules.maxAmbush times. objective.count is a wave; the reward is the escort's own.

info.name: Ambush on the Road

objective.text: Kill the ambushers before they reach {name}

info.onFail: {name} was struck down on the road.
info.rewardText: Nothing of its own: it counts toward the escort you are on
